title: Marit van Dijk at JCON 2026 — do we need an IDE when we have AI coding agents?
description: Marit van Dijk (JetBrains) walks through what's actually new in IntelliJ when you plug AI into it, and why reading code is suddenly a more valuable skill than writing it. When half of what you're reading wasn't written by a human, the old rules for code review don't quite apply.
playlistTitle: Marit van Dijk at JCON 2026 — do we need an IDE when we have AI coding agents?
